key_insight: Data-informed random features provide a compact basis for approximating Koopman generators and learning nonlinear continuous-time dynamics.
engineering_relevance: The approach supports efficient forecasting and system analysis while retaining the linear-operator structure of the Koopman framework.
method: Approximate the Koopman generator with a Galerkin method such as gEDMD.
Establish convergence of the approximated vector field and resulting trajectories.
evidence_signal: Numerical experiments demonstrate accurate forecasting and system analysis with faster computation than iterative optimization, though the abstract reports no quantitative benchmarks.
watch_item: gEDMD does not generally preserve exponential boundedness, so long-time stability requires careful checking.
paper_title: Data-driven Random-feature Approximation of Koopman Generators of Nonlinear Continuous-time Systems
